path_quoting.spaced_filename: file with space.txt (exact boundaries preserved in tree leaf)
path_quoting.wildcard_filename: literal*star.txt (literal asterisk preserved without glob expansion)
path_quoting.isolation: Wildcard characters do not expand or match unrelated files in repository

normalization: Baseline commit dates and author/committer identity are fixed.
Timestamps and author metadata are normalized across Git and wyag.
